# Flask

## Quickstart

Run your app with `run(host, port=5000)`. By default Flask starts on port 5000.

## Development Server

The built-in server runs on `http://localhost:5000` by default.

# HTTPX

## Quickstart

Create a client and call `get(url, timeout=5.0)`. The default timeout is 5 seconds.

## Configuration

The `timeout` parameter controls how long to wait for a response. Set to `5.0` by default.
